name: feature-cli-json
prompt: Add a `--json` flag to the CLI in `wc_cli.py`. Without `--json`, keep the existing plain-text output exactly as it is today. When `--json` is passed, instead of the plain-text lines, print a single line to stdout containing valid JSON (parseable by `json.loads`) with exactly three keys - `lines`, `words`, `chars` - as integers, and print nothing else to stdout in that mode. Usage stays `python3 wc_cli.py [--json] <path>`.
